components.css: .ds-stage{display:grid;gap:6px;position:relative}.ds-bar{position:relative;height:6px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--signal,#ff4a1c) 22%,transparent)}.ds-chip{position:absolute;top:-3px;left:0;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--signal,#ff4a1c);border:1px solid var(--ink,#14161a);animation:ds-cross 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1) infinite alternate}@keyframes ds-cross{from{left:0}to{left:calc(100% - 12px)}}.ds-stage-label{font-family:var(--font-cond,'Barlow Condensed'),sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink,#14161a)}

narrative.overview: The workspace is an engineering drawing sheet, not a dashboard of cards. Structure comes from 1px hairlines, a lettered and numbered zone grid, and a single signal orange. Light is warm paper with near-black ink; dark is a graphite sheet with chalk ink and the same orange. Corners are square, there are no shadows, no gradients and no glow.
keyCharacteristics: One hairline system: 1px rules, no card borders, no radius.
One signal colour, reserved for the primary action, the live or finished stage, selection and focus.
Condensed grotesk for headings and labels, plain Barlow for reading, mono only for code and the log.
Zone letters A-D across and numbers 1-2 down rule the margins on desktop.
Empty drawing areas carry corner registration marks instead of illustrations.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange marks only what is acting or acted on: the Generate button, a live or done stage, selection, focus. It never decorates headings, links or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange fills carry ink text (#14161a) in both themes.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Counts and figures use tabular numerals (.tnum).

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed for naming and labelling, Barlow for sentences; do not mix within a line.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats; separation is a 1px line or a 1px gap.

dos: Do separate panels with a 1px gap over #c8cbd0, and keep every border 1px.
Do use signal orange only for action, live or done state, selection and focus.
Do use ink text on orange fills and keep colour changes on buttons instant.
Do use condensed uppercase labels with 0.08-0.1em tracking for field and stage labels; Barlow for sentences.
Do show unavailable states with hatching and empty areas with registration marks.
donts: Don't use rounded corners, shadows, gradients, glow or glass.
Don't wrap content in cards; use zones.
Don't use orange for headings, links or decoration.
Don't use mono outside code and the log.
Don't use white text on orange.
